_meta.notes: Envelope webhook TikTok Shop (v2/current). `type: 1` = order status change (event_type ORDER_STATUS_CHANGE cuma konsep subscription, tidak ada di payload). order_status enum webhook: UNPAID, ON_HOLD, AWAITING_SHIPMENT, AWAITING_COLLECTION, CANCEL, IN_TRANSIT, DELIVERED, COMPLETED. Signature: header `Authorization` = hex lowercase HMAC-SHA256(app_secret, `${app_key}${rawBody}`); kompak tanpa spasi. ACK: HTTP 200 body kosong < 3 dtk; dedup by `tts_notification_id` (at-least-once, 4 retry: +2m/+30m/+3j/+12j).
